personality_one_liner: A high-clarity, professional command center merging fintech precision with a modern, minimal Islamic aesthetic.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for readability. Tightly group related data points within cards. Ensure safe area at all screen roots.

do's: Apply to the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Use for bottom sheet handles and full-screen modal scrims.
Ensure text on top of glass uses solid high-contrast onSurface colors.
dont's: Do not use on regular data cards or form fields.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure gateway for Manager, Content Team, and CS roles with Google and Email/Password options.

states.loading: Spinner on submit button, fields disabled.
states.error: Inline text below fields, or full-width error banner at top.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse). Logo/Text at the top 30%. Login cards/forms layered in a bottom sheet-style surface at the bottom 40%.

screens.name: Home (Manager Command Center)
screens.purpose: A 5-second snapshot of operational health spanning Tasks, Finance, Fundraising, and Content.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for KPI cards and chart areas.
states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'No Data Available for Today'.
states.error: Error boundary with 'Gagal memuat data' and a retry button.

screens.layout: Header: Net-worth style summary card showing 'Total Saldo' (Total Balance) with a soft green gradient. Quick Actions: 4 circular buttons in a row just below header. 'PERLU PERHATIAN' (Alerts): Horizontal scrolling list of warning cards. Grid of 2-col KPI cards (Fundraising, Content stats).

screens.name: Content
screens.purpose: Manage tasks, priorities, briefs, and content calendar.

states.empty: Folder icon with 'Belum ada konten hari ini' and a primary 'Tambah Konten' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky top segmented control (In Production, Review, Published). Vertical list of task cards. Each card has a status badge, priority tag, title, and a linear progress bar for the checklist.

screens.name: Fundraising
screens.purpose: Track monthly targets, donor count, and active programs.

states.loading: Skeletons for progress bars and list rows.

screens.layout: Top section: Large progress bar card showing 'Target Bulanan' achievement in %. Below: Sectioned list of recent donations with donor name, amount, and timestamp.

screens.name: Reports
screens.purpose: Financial summary with surplus/deficit and expense tracking with filters.
screens.layout: Filter row (sticky) with Date Picker triggers. Donut chart or summary block for Income vs Expenses. Scrollable list of detailed transactions categorized by type.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage role access, settings, and user details.
screens.layout: Header with user initials avatar in brandTertiary circle. Grouped list rows for settings (Edit Profile, Role Info, Logout) with chevrons.

login_background.alt: A minimal building illustration with a white and green roof

header_pattern.alt: Minimal geometric Islamic pattern behind a wooden arch

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Deep Green (#064E3B) and Soft Gold (#C5A059) palette. NO BLUE allowed anywhere in the app (used Teal #0D9488 for Info).
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all text elements to maintain a modern fintech and highly legible dashboard feel.

Implement the Command Center (Home) with a 'Net Worth' style header for financial balance, followed by horizontal quick actions, an alerts section ('PERLU PERHATIAN'), and a 2-column masonry or grid for KPIs.
Ensure all data screens (Content, Fundraising, Reports) implement Empty, Loading (Skeletons preferred), and Error states.
For the bottom navigation, use 5 tabs as requested: HOME, CONTENT, FUNDRAISING, REPORTS, PROFILE. Ensure safe area clearance at the bottom.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Ensure they are filled when active in the tab bar and outlined otherwise.
Cards should never be flush to the screen edge. Use minimum 'md' (12pt) or 'lg' (16pt) margin.
In the Content module, use progress bars inside task cards for checklist completion percentage.
Status badges (High/Medium/Low priority or Pending/Published) must use a combination of surfaceTertiary or status-specific light background with the corresponding bold text color.
Login screen must use the provided login_background image with a dark gradient scrim at the bottom to ensure the form and text remain legible.
